q1.question: What is the typical lead time for custom rubber parts?
q1.answer: Standard lead times range from 2-4 weeks for existing tooling, and 4-6 weeks for new tooling development. Prototype parts can often be delivered within 1-2 weeks using rapid tooling methods.

q2.question: How do I choose the right rubber material for my application?
q2.answer: Material selection depends on temperature range, chemical exposure, mechanical requirements, and application standards and operating conditions. Our material selection guide provides detailed comparison data, or contact our engineering team for recommendations.

q3.question: What tolerance levels can you achieve?
q3.answer: We routinely achieve ISO 3302 Class M1 tolerances (±0.05mm for small parts). Tighter tolerances are possible with specialized tooling and process control - consult our engineering team for feasibility.

q4.question: Do you provide PPAP documentation?
q4.answer: Yes, we provide full PPAP documentation including Level 3 submissions with all supporting data. Our quality management system is IATF 16949 certified, ensuring automotive-grade documentation standards.

q5.question: Can you work with customer-supplied materials?
q5.answer: Yes, we can process customer-supplied materials or source specific grades as required. All materials undergo incoming inspection and verification before use in production.
